findings.rule: Port placement — server-local port parked in vendor/shared
findings.explanation: ArchiveStore is named only by server code (the exports service, the fs adapter, the container); no package outside server/ references the exports feature, so the 'does any package outside server/ have to name this type?' test says no. vendor/shared is the hand-synced cross-package surface mirrored into client/, so a server-only port there widens the shared surface without buying any decoupling.
findings.fix: Declare ArchiveStore in server/src/adapters/archive/index.ts next to FsArchiveStore (the Tokenizer/Clock precedent) and remove it from vendor/shared/adapters.ts; it stays a port, resolved via the Container.

findings.rule: Compose only at the root / all external I/O through container ports (rules 3 & 6)
findings.explanation: ExportsService imports the concrete FsArchiveStore (line 2) and constructs it inline, sourcing its root directory and signing secret from process.env with a hardcoded 'dev-secret' fallback. This hard-wires an infrastructure concrete plus its configuration into the application ring, bypasses the composition root and the SecretsProvider/config path, and makes the archive impossible to swap via ContainerOverrides in tests.
findings.fix: Wire the archive store in platform/container.ts (an ArchiveStore field built from AppConfig/SecretsProvider, with an archive slot added to ContainerOverrides) and inject the ArchiveStore port into ExportsService via its constructor, like clock; the service then depends only on the interface.
